verdict.rationale: vLLM's source is publicly hosted at github.com/vllm-project/vllm, and the project documents building from source for development, so users can read the code. A community comment also refers to reading vLLM's large codebase. However, nothing in the pack names the license or confirms it is an open-source license. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an OSI-approved open license (e.g. a LICENSE file or license statement), and independent corroboration of the licensing terms.
